consequence.statement: No operational consequence for an operator: actions/setup-python is a GitHub Actions CI dependency of the repository (not part of the shipped controller image, Helm chart, or CRDs), so this bump does not affect upgraded external-secrets installations.

assertion.statement: The external-secrets repository's CI bumps the pinned actions/setup-python dependency from 5.4.0 to 5.5.0 (dependabot PR #4603), a CI-only change with no effect on deployed installations.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence is a CI-workflow (GitHub Actions) dependency bump and states no condition on a customer environment; actions/setup-python is not used by deployed external-secrets installations, so no exposure predicate can be truthfully written from this evidence.
